purpose: Determine whether an independent official ECB quarterly-financial-accounts quality benchmark supplies the domain-specific quantitative reconciliation rule required by the 2026-09-21 trigger-aware monitoring horizon, without rewriting any historical 0.1 million RON gate.

official_evidence.source: Euro area quarterly financial accounts — 2013 quality report
official_evidence.evidence: The report defines aggregation, horizontal, balancing-item and counterpart-sector consistency and states that discrepancies below EUR 10 million are considered acceptable in national data.

official_evidence.source: Euro area and national quarterly financial accounts — Quality report 2020
official_evidence.evidence: Internal discrepancies above EUR 10 million were observed for a few countries and generally corrected in later transmissions.

official_evidence.source: Euro area and national quarterly financial accounts — Quality report 2022
official_evidence.evidence: Internal discrepancies and unexplained negative stocks above EUR 10 million were observed in a few countries in 2022 and generally corrected later.

official_evidence.source: Euro area and national quarterly financial accounts — Quality report 2024
official_evidence.evidence: The report covers euro-area and non-euro EU countries, reports Romania at 96% of validation rules satisfied for Q4 2012-Q2 2024, and notes that internal discrepancies and unexplained negative stocks above EUR 10 million observed in 2023-2024 were generally corrected later.

official_exchange_rate_source.title: Romanian leu/Euro ECB reference exchange rate, Quarterly
official_exchange_rate_source.purpose: Convert the fixed EUR 10 million ECB QFA materiality benchmark into a quarter-specific million-RON threshold without choosing a threshold from observed RMD residuals.

scope_mapping.rmd_gate_alignment: The aggregate sectoral-financial-position gate tests accounting identities on the same public QFA-style sector/instrument stock-flow boundary. The new gate applies the ECB materiality benchmark at the instrument-quarter level rather than only to the F2-F8 aggregate.
scope_mapping.does_not_apply_to: Bilateral Accounting Spine completion, behavioural closure, parameter identification or causal validation.
